page.overview:
Who is Before They Were Famous Host?

The Before They Were Famous host is the individual who presents the television show Before They Were Famous. He introduces the context to clips of celebrities prior to their days of fame, and tends to react to them with amusement.

He also reported about Troy McClure's return to fame after he began dating Selma Bouvier.

The character design is based on , at the time host of .
